construction: Simultaneous chi-square intervals for p squared directional variances; rigorous interval outer bounds on covariance, DAG restrictions and total effects. No claim that local numerical extrema certify a sharp identified set.
metrics: True effect coverage, retention of both zero and positive effect, model count and outer width; exact population compatible-model effects also reported.
boundary: Last case violates the independent-error, causally sufficient model class. Nominal coverage applies only to models inside the supplied class.
